info.name: FIT4110 Lab05 Docker Compose Verification
info.description: End-to-end test cho stack Docker Compose Lab 05. API + AI service + DB.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response has status ok', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('service'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('version'); });
pm.test('Status code is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

pm.test('Response has reading_id and accepted', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('reading_id'); pm.expect(j.accepted).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.metric).to.eql('temperature'); });
const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.reading_id) { pm.environment.set('createdReadingId', j.reading_id); }
pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response has items array', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('items'); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('reading_id matches', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.reading_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('createdReadingId')); });
pm.test('Missing token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

pm.test('Error follows ProblemDetails', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('type'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status'); pm.expect(j.status).to.be.within(400,599); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('detail'); });

item.name: POST reading with wrong token returns 401

exec: pm.test('Wrong token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Error follows ProblemDetails', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('type'); pm.expect(j.status).to.be.within(400,599); });
pm.test('Missing required field returns 422', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });

pm.test('Error follows ProblemDetails', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('type'); pm.expect(j.status).to.be.within(400,599); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('detail'); });
pm.test('Wrong type returns 422', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test('Error follows ProblemDetails', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('detail'); });
pm.test('Non-existent reading returns 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('404 follows ProblemDetails', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status', 404); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('detail'); });
pm.test('Boundary 80 returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('X-Warning header present', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('X-Warning')).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Above boundary 81 returns 422', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test('Error follows ProblemDetails', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('detail'); });
pm.test('Lower boundary -40 returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Reading accepted', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.accepted).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Response time below 1000ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
pm.test('Health reachable', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('AI service health returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('AI service status ok', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(j.service).to.eql('ai-service'); });
pm.test('AI predict returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Prediction has objects and confidence', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('objects'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('confidence'); pm.expect(j.objects).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.confidence).to.be.an('array'); });
